source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Choose Speed of the Kill from [Vanguard of the Dark City](vsdata:ability/drukhari.raider.vanguard-of-the-dark-city) at the start of your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase). Until your next [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins, set up every **WYCHES** model leaving the Raider wholly within 6″ of it, except during an emergency [disembarkation](vsdata:core-rule/disembarking).

activeChoice.expires: start of next own Command phase
